title: 迷路
description: 迷路時尋求幫助的用語

sentences.en: Excuse me, I seem to have lost my way, and I was wondering if you could point me in the direction of the nearest subway station.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我好像迷路了，想請問你能不能指引我最近的地鐵站方向？

sentences.en: I have been walking for over an hour trying to find my hotel, which is supposed to be located somewhere near the central park.
sentences.zh: 我已經走了超過一小時試圖找到我的旅館，它應該在中央公園附近的某處。

sentences.en: Could you help me read this map, because I cannot figure out where I am in relation to the tourist district marked in red?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我看這張地圖嗎？因為我搞不清楚我和標成紅色的觀光區之間的相對位置。

sentences.en: My phone has died and I have no way to use GPS navigation, so I desperately need someone to give me verbal directions to the embassy.
sentences.zh: 我的手機沒電了，無法使用GPS導航，所以我非常需要有人口頭指引我去大使館。

sentences.en: I took a wrong turn about thirty minutes ago, and now I find myself in an unfamiliar neighborhood with no recognizable landmarks.
sentences.zh: 大約三十分鐘前我轉錯了彎，現在發現自己在一個陌生的社區，完全沒有認得的地標。

sentences.en: The street names in this area are written in characters I cannot read, which makes it impossible for me to follow the directions I was given.
sentences.zh: 這個區域的街道名稱是用我看不懂的文字寫的，這讓我根本無法按照別人給的指示走。

sentences.en: I was separated from my tour group while taking photographs at the temple, and now I have no idea how to get back to our meeting point.
sentences.zh: 我在寺廟拍照時和旅行團走散了，現在完全不知道怎麼回到我們的集合地點。

sentences.en: Would it be possible for you to write down the address of this location so that I can show it to a taxi driver later?
sentences.zh: 你能不能把這個地方的地址寫下來，這樣我之後可以給計程車司機看？

sentences.en: I am trying to reach the international airport, but every road I take seems to lead me further away from where I need to be.
sentences.zh: 我正試著到國際機場，但我走的每條路似乎都讓我離目的地越來越遠。

sentences.en: The directions that the hotel receptionist gave me earlier do not match the streets I am seeing, so I think I may have misunderstood something.
sentences.zh: 旅館櫃台人員之前給我的指引和我看到的街道對不上，所以我想我可能理解錯了什麼。

sentences.en: Since all the signs around here are in a language I cannot understand, I would really appreciate it if you could walk with me to the main road.
sentences.zh: 因為這附近所有的標示都是我看不懂的語言，如果你能陪我走到大馬路，我會非常感激。

sentences.en: I remember passing a large fountain and a bookstore before I got lost, so perhaps those landmarks can help you understand where I came from.
sentences.zh: 我記得迷路前經過一座大噴泉和一間書店，也許這些地標可以幫你了解我從哪裡來的。

sentences.en: My children are waiting for me at the hotel, and I am getting increasingly anxious because I cannot find my way back before dark.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子們在旅館等我，我越來越焦慮，因為我無法在天黑前找到回去的路。

sentences.en: Is there a bus or train from here that goes directly to the city center, where most of the major hotels and tourist attractions are located?
sentences.zh: 從這裡有沒有直達市中心的公車或火車？大部分的大型旅館和觀光景點都在那裡。

sentences.en: I stepped off the bus at what I thought was the correct stop, but nothing around me looks like the descriptions in my travel guidebook.
sentences.zh: 我在我以為正確的站下了車，但周圍的一切看起來都不像旅遊指南書上描述的。

sentences.en: The GPS on my phone keeps redirecting me in circles, and I suspect it might not be working properly due to poor signal in this area.
sentences.zh: 我手機上的GPS一直讓我繞圈子，我懷疑可能是這個區域信號不好導致它運作不正常。

sentences.en: Could you tell me approximately how far it is from here to the train station, and whether it would be faster to walk or take a taxi?
sentences.zh: 你能告訴我從這裡到火車站大概多遠嗎？走路去還是搭計程車比較快？

sentences.en: I am a tourist who arrived only yesterday, and I am completely unfamiliar with the layout of this city and its public transportation system.
sentences.zh: 我是昨天才到的遊客，對這個城市的佈局和公共交通系統完全不熟悉。

sentences.en: After wandering through several narrow alleys that all look the same, I have completely lost my sense of direction and cannot find the exit.
sentences.zh: 穿過好幾條看起來一模一樣的窄巷後，我完全失去了方向感，找不到出口。

sentences.en: I was supposed to meet my friend at the museum thirty minutes ago, but I have been unable to locate the building despite following the signs.
sentences.zh: 我三十分鐘前就該在博物館和朋友碰面了，但儘管跟著標示走，我還是找不到那棟建築。

sentences.en: If I continue walking straight along this road, will I eventually reach the waterfront area where the ferry terminal is located?
sentences.zh: 如果我沿著這條路一直走，最終會到達渡輪碼頭所在的濱水區嗎？

sentences.en: I accidentally got on the wrong train and ended up in a suburb that I have never heard of, with no idea how to get back.
sentences.zh: 我不小心搭錯了火車，到了一個我從未聽過的郊區，完全不知道怎麼回去。

sentences.en: The hiking trail that was supposed to be well-marked has become impossible to follow due to the dense fog that rolled in this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 原本應該標示清楚的健行步道，因為今天下午濃霧來襲而變得無法辨認方向。

sentences.en: I need to find a police station or information center where someone can help me figure out my current location on this map.
sentences.zh: 我需要找一個警察局或服務中心，有人可以幫我在這張地圖上確認我目前的位置。

sentences.en: Do you happen to know whether there is a landmark or tall building nearby that I could use as a reference point to orient myself?
sentences.zh: 你是否知道附近有沒有什麼地標或高樓，我可以用來作為參考點辨別方向？

sentences.en: I have been trying to follow the directions on my phone, but the street names do not correspond to any of the signs I can see around me.
sentences.zh: 我一直試著照手機上的指示走，但街道名稱和我周圍看到的標示都對不上。

sentences.en: The area I am in right now feels quite unsafe after dark, so I would appreciate any help getting to a main road where I can find transportation.
sentences.zh: 我目前所在的區域天黑後感覺很不安全，所以如果能幫我到有交通工具的大馬路，我會很感激。

sentences.en: I left the restaurant intending to walk back to my hotel, but after several turns I realized that nothing around me looks familiar at all.
sentences.zh: 我離開餐廳打算走回旅館，但轉了幾個彎之後發現周圍完全沒有熟悉的東西。

sentences.en: Since I do not have mobile data and cannot connect to the internet, I am relying entirely on the kindness of strangers to find my way.
sentences.zh: 因為我沒有行動數據也無法連上網路，我完全依賴陌生人的善心來找路。

sentences.en: Would you mind calling this phone number for me and asking the person who answers to come pick me up from wherever I am right now?
sentences.zh: 你介意幫我打這個電話號碼，請接電話的人來我目前所在的地方接我嗎？
